text:
alex: Runtime 4.0 landed in canary; quick note: we're seeing occasional auth handshake delays when mixing quantized models. Should we pin models that use quantized backends?
mei: Observed p95 rise ~20ms on quant routes, p99 spikes on retries. Not universal but reproducible on a few hosts.
tarun: SDKs look fine but a couple infra tests still set runtime=3.9. Full unpin could break them. Suggest model-level pin for quant groups.
deploybot: Dry-run pinlist change:
``napply preview --add 'model_group: quant-core -> runtime:3.9 expires:3h'
result: ok, hosts impacted: 6
```
alex: Plan: apply model-level pin to 3.9 for quant-core & quant-edge for 3h, trigger cache warm-up, escalate to rollback if p99>200ms sustained 5m or error-rate>0.2%. Tarun/Mei own rollback.
mei: I'll start warm-up job and bump trace sampling for the quant groups.
tarun: I'll notify SDK owners to avoid hard pins and prepare rollback commands.
sre-bot: Preflight CI: canary health checks passed; one flaky integration test noted.
alex: Applying the pin in 2m. Log it in release notes and link to the rollback snippet.
mei: Warm-up started. Observability tags added.
tarun: Notified SDK owners in #eng-platform. PR for docs update filed.
alex: Scoped pin applied. Monitoring closely.
